content:
We need to propose a retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <= $9999. Need to construct JSON route with reactions and template IDs.

We have some template IDs from search results: 401931, 485615, 659569, 302360, 1010408. Need to pick plausible disconnections.

Target: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Structure: a tolyl sulfonamide attached to a phenyl ring bearing a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide (cinnamamide) attached to an aniline (anilide). So overall: p-tolyl-sulfonyl-phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-phenyl-NH2? Actually the amide attaches to an aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So the amide nitrogen is attached to an aniline (para-aminophenyl). So we have a sulfonamide linking two phenyl rings, and an amide linking to an aniline.

Potential disconnections:
1) Break sulfonamide: separate sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) and aniline (p-toluidine). So we could get p-toluidine (commercial) and 4-(phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2) phenyl sulfonyl chloride? Actually sulfonyl chloride derived from 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride? But we need sulfonyl attached to phenyl bearing the cinnamamide side chain. So we could start from 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride then do Suzuki coupling with p-tolyl boronic acid? But that adds extra step.

Alternative: Break amide: use aniline (commercial) and cinnamic acid derivative (e.g., trans-cinnamic acid) then amide coupling (e.g., using EDC). So step 1: amide formation between trans-cinnamic acid (or trans-3-phenylacrylic acid) and 4-aminophenyl (the aniline attached to sulfonyl phenyl). Actually the amide nitrogen is attached to an aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So the amide is -C(=O)-NH-Ph-NH2 (anilide). So we could start from trans-cinnamic acid and 4-aminophenyl sulfonyl phenyl? Wait the aniline is part of the amide, not the sulfonamide. The sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to p-tolyl (the left phenyl). The other side of sulfonyl is the phenyl bearing the cinnamamide side chain. So the amide nitrogen is attached to that phenyl side chain? Actually the SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Interpretation: p-tolyl (Cc1ccc...cc1) attached via N to sulfonyl group S(=O)(=O) attached to phenyl (c2ccc(... )cc2). That phenyl has substituent /C=C/C(=O)N c3ccccc3N (i.e., trans-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2). So the amide nitrogen is attached to phenyl (c3ccccc3N) which also has an NH2 (aniline). So the amide is attached to an aniline (para-aminophenyl). So we have an aniline with an amide substituent (anilide). So we could break amide to give trans-cinnamic acid and 4-aminophenyl (aniline) which is commercially available (p-phenylenediamine? Actually the aniline is phenyl with NH2 at para? The SMILES c3ccccc3N is aniline (no substitution). So it's just aniline (C6H5NH2). So we can use aniline as nucleophile for amide formation with trans-cinnamic acid (or its activated derivative). That's step 1.

Step 2: Build the phenyl-sulfonyl phenyl connection. Could start from 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride and do Suzuki coupling with p-tolyl boronic acid to give the sulfonyl phenyl with p-tolyl attached via N? Wait sulfonamide formation: we need sulfonyl chloride reacting with p-toluidine (p-methyl aniline) to give sulfonamide. So we need sulfonyl chloride that already has the phenyl bearing the cinnamamide side chain. So we need 4-(cinnamamide) phenyl sulfonyl chloride. That could be prepared from 4-(cinnamamide) phenyl sulfonic acid (or sulfonyl chloride). Could we get commercially 4-(cinnamoyl)benzenesulfonyl chloride? Probably not.

Alternative route: first form sulfonamide between p-toluidine and 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride to give p-tolyl-sulfonamide attached to phenyl bromide. Then do Suzuki coupling to attach the cinnamamide side chain onto the phenyl bromide (via Heck maybe). But we need ≤3 steps total. Could we do two steps: 1) amide formation (cinnamic acid + aniline) gives cinnamamide (trans). 2) sulfonamide formation between p-toluidine and sulfonyl chloride derived from phenyl with that cinnamamide substituent. That would be 2 steps if we have the sulfonyl chloride as commercial. Is there a commercial 4-(cinnamoyl)benzenesulfonyl chloride? Not likely.

Maybe we can reverse: first form sulfonamide between p-toluidine and 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride to give intermediate A (p-tolyl-sulfonamide-phenyl-Br). Then do Heck coupling of the bromophenyl with trans-cinnamic acid derivative (like methyl trans-cinnamate) to install the side chain, then convert ester to amide with aniline. That's 3 steps.

But we need leaves commercially available: p-toluidine, 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride, methyl trans-cinnamate, aniline, coupling reagents (but reagents not counted). So 3 steps.

We need to find templates for sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride). Also for Suzuki/Heck coupling (aryl bromide + alkene). Also for amide formation (acid + amine). Use template IDs from search results maybe correspond to amide formation (template 401931 seems to involve amide formation with double bond). Let's inspect template 401931: retro_smarts shows something like [#7:2]-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:3])/[CH;D2;+0:4]=[C:5]>>... This looks like amide formation from an amide and alkene? Actually forward reaction: amide + alkene? Not sure.

Better to search for sulfonamide formation template.
Search for functional groups formed: sulfonamide.
